page_title: VAL 1-2 OVI | Valencia v Oviedo 30/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' The match has just finished.
90+10' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Valencia comes to nothing.
90+10' Largie Ramazani (Valencia) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle. R. Oviedo earn a free kick.
90+6' Pepelu (Valencia) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders. It's a throw-in for Valencia.
90+4' Valencia have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+3' Luka Ilic (R. Oviedo) must have forgotten he already has a yellow card on his account today. He receives a second one and is dismissed.
90' We will have 9 min. of added time.
88' Veljko Paunovic decides to make a substitution. Haissem Hassan will be replaced by David Costas (R. Oviedo).

86' 1 - 2 A superb goal from great team play! Salomon Rondon (R. Oviedo) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent shot inside the left post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
86' Here comes a substitution. Largie Ramazani (Valencia) is brought on as a substitute for Luis Rioja.
85' 1 - 1 What a hit! Luka Ilic (R. Oviedo) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot inside the left post. 1:1.
84' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for R. Oviedo.
84' Santiago Colombatto (R. Oviedo) and Leander Dendoncker combine well with a quick one-two and their attacking move continues.
82' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
81' Haissem Hassan (R. Oviedo) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
79' A cross from a corner kick by Valencia is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
78' Carlos Corberan has decided to make a change. Dani Raba (Valencia) replaces Arnaut Danjuma.
77' Veljko Paunovic appears to have said too much and referee Ricardo De Burgos comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
76' Substitution. Ilyas Chaira (R. Oviedo) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Alberto Reina walks off.
76' The manager makes a subsitution with Salomon Rondon (R. Oviedo) coming on for Federico Vinas.
75' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots to the right post, but Aaron Escandell leaps out to thwart his attempt.
75' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
74' The Valencia players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

72' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Valencia.
71' Tempers flare after Luka Ilic (R. Oviedo) commits a foul. He receives a yellow card for his bad challenge and surely must be relieved at not receiving a red card.
71' Luis Rioja (Valencia) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
70' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Alberto Reina (R. Oviedo) is given a yellow card.
68' The defence successfully catches Rahim Alhassane (R. Oviedo) in the offside trap, but it was close!
67' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) superbly wins the ball back and has a go from distance, but sends his effort high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for R. Oviedo.
65' A substitution has been made. Josip Brekalo is replaced by Luka Ilic (R. Oviedo).

65' Chance! Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Diego Lopez, but his shot from inside the box flashes inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and R. Oviedo will have a goal kick.
64' The linesman signals a throw-in for R. Oviedo.
61' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Federico Vinas (R. Oviedo) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
61' Federico Vinas (R. Oviedo) is penalised for a foul. Ricardo De Burgos had a clear view and blows his whistle. Valencia have been awarded a free kick.
61' Pepelu (Valencia) and Lucas Beltran combine brilliantly in a series of one-twos.
60' A raking crossfield pass from Luis Rioja (Valencia) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
59' Fouls committed – 9:8.
57' Josip Brekalo (R. Oviedo) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
56' Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
55' Substitution. Hugo Duro is replaced by Lucas Beltran (Valencia).
55' Carlos Corberan has decided to substitute Javi Guerra and he is replaced by Pepelu (Valencia).
55' That's the end of the game for Andre Almeida, who is replaced by Diego Lopez (Valencia).
54' Close! Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot narrowly over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for R. Oviedo.
51' Rahim Alhassane (R. Oviedo) threads a pass through to Josip Brekalo, but Julen Agirrezabala breaks up the move. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
50' Haissem Hassan (R. Oviedo) brings down the pass, looks up and shoots from distance, but it's straight at a defender who unwittingly blocks it.
48' David Carmo (R. Oviedo) brings an opponent down and Ricardo De Burgos interrupts the game. There is a free kick near the sideline to Valencia.
47' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
46' A player from R. Oviedo commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle. Valencia win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
46' The whistle blows and Ricardo De Burgos starts the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Javi Guerra (Valencia) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. R. Oviedo have a free kick.

44' Santiago Colombatto (R. Oviedo) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot towards the left side of the goal. His effort is blocked by Julen Agirrezabala with a brilliant diving save!
43' The corner is swung in but Valencia can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
42' Baptiste Santamaria (Valencia) plays a terrific long ball forward to Arnaut Danjuma, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
41' Federico Vinas (R. Oviedo) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.

40' Jose Gaya (Valencia) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. R. Oviedo are given an advantage. They have a free kick.

38' The most active player in today's match is definitely Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia). He's trying to be on the ball as much as possible and you can literally see the enthusiasm in his play. He keeps exchanging some one touch passes and waits for the right moment to send a killer pass. What a player!

37' Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle and it's Alberto Reina (R. Oviedo) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. It's a free kick to Valencia, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
37' Santiago Colombatto (R. Oviedo) and Federico Vinas combine well with a quick one-two and their attacking move continues.
34' Haissem Hassan (R. Oviedo) sends an accurate short pass. Alberto Reina controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
33' Javi Guerra (Valencia) sends a long ball forward to Arnaut Danjuma, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is out of play. R. Oviedo will have a throw-in.
31' The foul by Javi Guerra (Valencia) was seen by Ricardo De Burgos who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. That's a free kick to R. Oviedo.
30' Santiago Colombatto (R. Oviedo) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
29' Rough tackle by Jose Gaya (Valencia). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to R. Oviedo.

27' Baptiste Santamaria (Valencia) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom left corner is, however, superbly saved by Aaron Escandell! The ball goes out of play and R. Oviedo will have a goal kick.
25' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for R. Oviedo.
24' Valencia can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
23' The ball is cleared after Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Corner kick. Valencia will have an opportunity.
22' Julen Agirrezabala (Valencia) will take a goal kick to hopefully start an attacking move for his team.
22' Josip Brekalo (R. Oviedo) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
20' The ball possession is 63:37.
19' Andre Almeida is able to continue with the attacking effort as he latches on to a beautiful defence-splitting lofted pass, which was supplied by Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia).
18' Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle as Leander Dendoncker (R. Oviedo) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. Valencia are awarded the free kick.
17' Josip Brekalo (R. Oviedo) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
15' Rahim Alhassane (R. Oviedo) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
15' The ball is out of play. R. Oviedo will take a throw-in.

12' Leander Dendoncker (R. Oviedo) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Valencia in a dangerous position.
12' The ball has crossed the sideline. Valencia are taking a throw-in.
10' A pass into the box finds Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Aaron Escandell denies him.
8' Javi Guerra (Valencia) and Baptiste Santamaria combine well with a quick one-two to trick their opponent.
6' Luis Rioja (Valencia) unleashes a shot from long range but it's well blocked.

4' 1 - 0 Goal! Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a brilliant pass and fires a first-time shot inside the right post. Luis Rioja assisted in the goal. 1:0.
3' Josip Brekalo (R. Oviedo) commits a rough foul. Ricardo De Burgos stops the game and makes a call. Valencia are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
1' Baptiste Santamaria (Valencia) finds Luis Rioja with a nice pass so he can go on towards the goal.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
R. Oviedo will kick-off.
